response.sql: WITH filtered_labs AS (SELECT * FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC >= 6.5), per_status_averages AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(CASE WHEN GOT IS NOT NULL AND GPT IS NOT NULL THEN GOT - GPT END) as avg_got_minus_gpt, AVG(CASE WHEN APPT IS NOT NULL AND PT IS NOT NULL THEN APPT - PT END) as avg_appt_minus_pt FROM filtered_labs GROUP BY CENTROMEA) SELECT AVG(avg_got_minus_gpt) as avg_ast_minus_alt, AVG(avg_appt_minus_pt) as avg_appt_minus_pt FROM per_status_averages

alternatives.interpretation: "Skipping records where a difference can't be computed" applies globally to both calculations (i.e., skip records where either GOT, GPT, APPT, or PT is NULL), rather than skipping independently for each difference.
alternatives.sql: WITH filtered_labs AS (SELECT * FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC >= 6.5 AND GOT IS NOT NULL AND GPT IS NOT NULL AND APPT IS NOT NULL AND PT IS NOT NULL), per_status_averages AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(GOT - GPT) as avg_got_minus_gpt, AVG(APPT - PT) as avg_appt_minus_pt FROM filtered_labs GROUP BY CENTROMEA) SELECT AVG(avg_got_minus_gpt) as avg_ast_minus_alt, AVG(avg_appt_minus_pt) as avg_appt_minus_pt FROM per_status_averages
